canonicalization.capabilities: compiler-derived unique UTF-8 byte-order sorted union over every component
canonicalization.json: recursive UTF-8 key order, NFC strings, two spaces, LF, one trailing LF
canonicalization.requiredSecrets: compiler emits unique UTF-8 byte-order sorted names
canonicalization.skillFiles: compiler emits the whole component asset directory as behavior.files, UTF-8 byte-order sorted by path, entry point SKILL.md
canonicalization.urls: compiler emits new URL(value).href after HTTPS/hostname/no-userinfo validation

graph.rootDependencies: exactly the set of every non-root component id
